paper_title: Constraining dark photon parameters based on the very high energy observations of blazars
coupling_convention: kinetic mixing parameter epsilon (dimensionless), as plotted on y-axis of Fig. 4
notes: Paper derives 95% C.L. exclusion on dark photon kinetic mixing from photon-dark photon scattering (gamma+gamma' -> e+e-) of VHE photons from blazars Mrk 421 and Mrk 501 (HEGRA data), dominated by the DM spike around the host-galaxy SMBH. No numerical table is provided; the only explicit numbers in text are epsilon ~ 1e-7 at 95% C.L. over m_D ~ 0.03-1 eV (benchmark: ECPL spectral model, Dominguez EBL, R_em = 4Rs). Encoded as a flat two-point bound over that stated validity range; full exclusion curves in Fig. 4 extend over 1e-2 to 1e4 eV but values are not readable from text. The bound assumes dark photons constitute all DM along the line of sight (spike normalization from SMBH mass uncertainty; Milky Way NFW with local density 0.4 GeV/cm^3), but this is an astrophysical absorption limit, not a haloscope, so dm_density_assumed left null. Limits weaken substantially for conservative spike assumptions (R_em = 1e4 Rs, gamma_sp = 1.5, or no spike). | [VISION GATE D] vision notes admit tracing a compilation envelope ('envelope of the Mrk 421 (red) and Mrk 501 (black) solid exclusion curves') rather than the paper's own single curve | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.7, 50)) | Vision: Main result is Fig. 4 (ECPL spectral model, R_em = 4R_s, NFW+spike). Traced the lower envelope of the Mrk 421 (red) and Mrk 501 (black) solid exclusion curves; Mrk 501 extends the low-mass edge to ~0.02 eV, Mrk 421 gives the lowest epsilon over most of the range. Text confirms epsilon ~ 1e-7 at 95% C.L. for m_D ~ 0.03-1 eV. Vertical low-mass cutoff at m ~ 0.022 eV due to scattering energy threshold. Curves are wiggly (grid steps); rising branch approximated by its mean power-law trend. Dashed lines (Solar, CAST, Crab) are prior constraints, not traced.
